# Offer 1: Soviet Advisory Mission (SOV)
COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_pair_clear = {
	country_exists = AFG
	country_exists = SOV
	AFG = { NOT = { has_war_with = SOV } }
	AFG = {
		NOT = { is_embargoing = SOV }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = SOV }

				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = SOV }
			}
		}
	}
	SOV = {
		NOT = { is_embargoing = AFG }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = AFG }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = AFG }

				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = AFG }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = AFG }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = AFG }
			}
		}

}

	COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_pair_clear = yes
	AFG = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_signed }
	SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_consent }
}
COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_can_accept = {
	OR = { tag = SOV }
	has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_pending
	NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_consent }
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_sender_tt
		has_variable = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_sender
		var:COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_sender = { tag = AFG }
	}
	country_exists = AFG
	AFG = {
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_open
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_signed }
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_same_government_tt
			check_variable = { ruling_party = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_party }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_pair_clear = yes
}
COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_answer_valid = {
	country_exists = SOV
	SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_consent }

		tooltip = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_same_government_tt

			}
		}
	}
	CHI = {
		NOT = { is_embargoing = AFG }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = AFG }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = AFG }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = AFG }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = AFG }
